note: Small MDC boat access on the Osage River arm of Truman Lake beside the Route H bridge: a concrete ramp, a large gravel parking loop and five marked primitive camping spots. The spots have no built pads; they sit along the gravel lot and access road with bottomland timber between them and the river. No toilets or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC designates camping here (page 'marked primitive camping spots', map 'Primitive Camping (5 Individual Sites)', one GIS point at the lot edge) - stays under the lot rule. Site count 5 written. Phone matches. WATERFRONT LEAD: riverview not supported - recommend not waterfront.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS: the page says 'A concrete boat ramp, gravel parking lot and marked primitive camping spots are available' and lists 'Individual Campsites'; the 04/14 map legend has 'Primitive Camping (5 Individual Sites)' with the symbol labelled '5 Sites' on the west side of the gravel access road about 190 m south of the Parking Lot symbol; GIS layer 27 has one 'Primitive Camping Area' point at 38.00328,-93.99583, at the north-west corner of the gravel lot (17 m from the GIS lot point), where imagery shows a truck and boat trailer parked. Imagery shows no built pads, rings or tables anywhere: a gravel loop about 170 m long with a wide west arm, then a single gravel lane south to SW 200 with a mown strip and closed timber on its west side. The map and the GIS point disagree by about 200 m on where the five spots are; neither place shows anything but gravel and grass. It is designated lot-side camping and nothing more.

WATERFRONT LEAD (stored riverview; recommend NOT WATERFRONT): the GIS camping point at the lot corner is about 55 m from the bank of the Osage arm (channel about 75 m wide here), with a band of bottomland timber about 40 m deep between; the only open line to the water is down the boat-ramp cut 40 m east of the point, which is the day-use ramp. The map's '5 Sites' position is about 250 m from the river with the whole lot and the timber between. From either, the river would be seen only through leaf-off timber or down the ramp. Not riverview on what can be seen; unsure goes down.
ACREAGE: the page's Quick Facts say 0.0 acres (which the stored note copied as '0 acres'); the map says 5 acres. Note rewritten without it.
PIN: stored 38.00328,-93.99583 = GIS camping point, on the gravel at the lot's north-west corner. No move.

ACCESS: paved Route H to the gravel entrance at SW 200, 350 m of gravel lane, large turnaround loop. No posted limit. The lot is low bottomland beside Truman Lake's Osage arm and will flood at high pool (no closure posted now).
PHONE: stored 417-853-4592 matches the page's 'For more information call (417) 853-4592'.
Nothing else in the database within 3 km. No split.
